title: On Symmetry for Characterizing Agent Heterogeneity in Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2610.18538v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Understanding agent heterogeneity can inform the design of shared and agent-specific policy representations, however existing criteria provide no unified structural test. We study finite-horizon POSGs and define a type-compatible transformation as a policy-evaluation symmetry when complete policy evaluation commutes with it for every decentralized behavioral policy. Policy-evaluation symmetries form a group for which agent orbits define structural agent types. This classification does not depend on the particular policy chosen or the distribution of initial states. We prove that every componentwise environment automorphism is a policy-evaluation symmetry, but that the converse does not hold. Applying the framework to cooperative Dec-POMDPs shows that agents can belong to different structural types even when they share a common reward. For prescribed weighted reward aggregation, we derive an exact value identity and sufficient condition

translated_title: 论用对称性刻画多智能体系统中的智能体异质性
translated_abstract: 理解智能体异质性可以为共享策略表示和特定智能体策略表示的设计提供指导，然而现有判据缺乏统一的结构性检验方法。我们研究有限时域部分可观测随机博弈，定义了一类类型兼容变换：当完整策略评估与该变换对每一个去中心化行为策略均可交换时，称之为策略评估对称性。策略评估对称性构成一个群，其轨道定义了结构性的智能体类型。该分类不依赖于所选取的特定策略或初始状态分布。我们证明了每个逐分量的环境自同构都是策略评估对称性，但反之不成立。将该框架应用于合作式Dec-POMDP表明，即使智能体共享相同的奖励，它们也可能属于不同的结构类型。对于给定的加权奖励聚合方式，我们推导出了精确的价值恒等式及充分条件。
tldr: 本文提出以策略评估对称性作为统一的结构性判据来刻画多智能体系统中的智能体异质性，证明环境自同构是对称性的充分而非必要条件，并揭示共享相同奖励的智能体也可能属于不同的结构类型。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces policy-evaluation symmetries as a unified structural criterion for characterizing agent heterogeneity in multi-agent systems, proving that environment automorphisms are sufficient but not necessary for such symmetries, and showing that agents sharing a common reward can still belong to different structural types.
